title: Bombeiro
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Bombeiro para atuar no nosso time de Controle de Emergências - Segurança do Trabalho.

Quais as responsabilidades?

  • Atuar nas emergências conforme os procedimentos operacionais padrão de cada cenário emergencial;
  • Organizar, capacitar e coordenar as brigadas industriais e agrícolas;
  • Conduzir veículos de emergência (ambulância e caminhão pipa);
  • Programar e executar teste, inspeção, ensaio, limpeza, substituição e/ou reposição de equipamentos, veículos, sistemas de proteção de combate a incêndio e de atendimento as emergências;
  • Treinar os brigadistas em combate a incêndio, vazamentos de produtos químicos, primeiros socorros e outros;
  • Registrar as intervenções, elaborar relatórios de simulados, intercorrências e atas de turno;
  • Organizar, conduzir e ou coordenar simulado de emergências conforme os cenários de riscos mapeados;
  • Liberação e monitoramento de trabalho a quente, principalmente em áreas críticas.

Quais os requisitos?

  • Obrigatório curso de bombeiro profissional civil (Vigente);
  • Obrigatório CNH no mínimo categoria C (vigente);
  • Obrigatório curso de transporte de veículos de emergência (vigente);
  • Obrigatório pacote office em nível básico;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos;
  • Residir em Pitangueiras/SP;
  • Desejável formação de técnico em segurança do trabalho (diferencial)
  • Desejável experiência como bombeiro civil no setor sucroenergético (diferencial);

Qual localidade?

Pitangueiras/SP.

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.


Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?


Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.


Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
  • Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality. 
  • Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
  • Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality. 
  • Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
  • Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
  • This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview


Requirements Before Employment

  • Signed Confidentiality agreement
  • Signed Non-compete agreement
  • Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
  • We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
  • Hours 8AM - 5PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included
company: TD Media LLC (dba Life Water Media)

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.

Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.

Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.

We need tutors who can start immediately!

Characteristics

Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite

Requirements

  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.

About LatinHire

Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Cloud Pleno
description:
Buscamos um(a) Analista de Infraestrutura Cloud Pleno sua missão é garantir que a aplicação tenha condições de ser executada adequadamente no ambiente do cliente. title: Anaplan Developer
description:
This a Remote full-time position in Brazil working with US clients.


We offer:

  • 100% Remote Work
  • Salary R$14,000 gross monthly
  • Vale Refeição / Alimentação R$ 992,00
  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco ( Descontos Sujeito a Alteração)
  • Plano Odontológico Bradesco
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche


Title: Anaplan Developer

The Role of the Board Developer is to understand the requirements of the specific regions related to the Price Management Tool and Sales Planning & Forecasting applications. Based on that the Board Developer implements and enhances solutions within these applications. The Board Developer also supports in Maintenance and Support of the existing solutions.


Required Qualifications:

  • Review and understand client requirements as defined during Board scoping and analysis phases.
  • Translate business requirements into technical solutions through implementations and enhancements within the Board platform.
  • Design and implement Board capsules, procedures, and data models that align with business logic and performance expectations.
  • Optimize existing functionalities and incorporate new features to improve solution efficiency and user experience.
  • Collaborate with Business Analysts and Data Engineers to ensure seamless integration between data sources, models, and user-facing applications.
  • Support solution testing in conjunction with the Tester role, ensuring configurations meet functional and technical specifications.
  • Provide UAT support and assist with deployment activities to ensure smooth transition to production.
  • Provide candid, meaningful feedback and progress updates in a timely manner to the Project Manager, Business Partner, and team.
  • Stay current with Board platform updates and best practices, applying new features and enhancements to improve solution quality.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + React)
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java + React) to join our team and help build scalable, high-performance applications. In this role, you will work primarily on backend development using Java 17 and Spring Boot, while also contributing to modern frontend solutions built with React and related technologies. You will be involved in designing and implementing cloud-native services and APIs, collaborating closely with frontend engineers, QA, and product teams to deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across the stack, applying best practices in software architecture, performance, and security.


Responsibilities


  • Develop and maintain scalable backend services using Java 17 and Spring Boot.
  • Work with React, JavaScript, Node.js, Next.js, and related frontend technologies as part of full-stack solutions.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices architectures.
  • Deploy, manage, and maintain applications in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Optimize application performance and apply security best practices across services.
  • Partner with frontend developers, QA engineers, and product teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, following best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and support the technical growth of other engineers.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues efficiently and responsibly.


Required Qualifications


  • Proven experience with Java 17 and the Spring Boot framework.
  • Solid experience building backend services and APIs in distributed systems.
  • Strong proficiency in frontend technologies such as React, JavaScript, Node.js, and Next.js
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Knowledge of microservices architecture and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, Couchbase, Elastic).
  • Strong understanding of security principles and best practices in backend development.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate effectively across teams.


Nice To Have Skills

  • Experience with messaging systems such as Solace.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Splunk, New Relic).
  • Exposure to AI-related concepts or tools applied to software development.

title: Customer Success (CS) – Tur.com
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional dedicado(a) e orientado(a) para Customer Success (CS), que desempenhará um papel fundamental na implementação e no sucesso contínuo dos Operadores Turísticos no Marketplace de Tours, Atividades e Atrações da tur.com no Brasil. -->


O(a) CS será responsável por orientar novos Vendors no uso eficaz da nossa plataforma, garantindo sua satisfação, crescimento e fidelização. Atuará como ponte entre os times de Produto, Vendas e Suporte, contribuindo diretamente para a melhoria da experiência de pós-venda.


Responsabilidades

Implementação e Treinamento

● Coordenar a implementação de novos Vendors, garantindo uma transição fluida desde a assinatura do contrato até a ativação no Marketplace.

● Oferecer treinamentos detalhados sobre o uso da plataforma, assegurando que os Operadores Turísticos compreendam todas as funcionalidades disponíveis.

Suporte Contínuo

● Atuar como principal ponto de contato para os Vendors, prestando suporte contínuo e solucionando dúvidas ou problemas.

● Monitorar o desempenho dos Vendors na plataforma e fornecer recomendações para melhorar sua presença e aumentar as vendas.

● Trabalhar em parceria com o time de Atendimento ao Cliente para resolver problemas oriundos dos clientes finais e coordenar ajustes necessários com os Operadores Turísticos.

Sucesso do Vendor

● Desenvolver estratégias personalizadas para melhorar o desempenho de cada Vendor, identificando oportunidades de crescimento e otimização.

● Coletar feedback e colaborar com o time de Produto para aprimorar funcionalidades-chave.


Requisitos

● Experiência prévia em Customer Success, preferencialmente no setor de turismo ou áreas relacionadas.

● Idiomas: Espanhol e Português. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.

● Capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas dos Operadores Turísticos e desenvolver soluções personalizadas.

● Disponibilidade para viagens ocasionais, conforme a necessidade do cliente.

● Perfil orientado a resultados, com histórico de garantir o sucesso dos clientes.

● Conhecimento básico de plataformas CRM e ferramentas de atendimento ao cliente.


Oferecemos

● Salário competitivo.

● Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inovador e colaborativo.

● Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.


Se você é apaixonado(a) por garantir o sucesso dos clientes, trabalhar em equipe e contribuir para o crescimento do nosso Marketplace, te convidamos a se juntar a nós!

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Delphi Sênior (IA)
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Ser referência no desenvolvimento e sustentação de funcionalidades de software, de modo que não apenas agregue valor ao produto como também oriente e capacite o time de desenvolvimento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e a evolução técnica do time de desenvolvimento do produto de atuação. Especialidade em Backend.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Desenvolver soluções técnicas de alta complexidade, transformando requisitos em software robusto, seguro e escalável, alinhado às necessidades do negócio;
  • Atuar na análise e evolução da arquitetura de software, assegurando organização, consistência, performance e eficiência de seus componentes;
  • Garantir a aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software, incluindo testes automatizados, versionamento, revisões de código, documentação e integração contínua;
  • Detalhar requisitos técnicos complexos em colaboração com clientes e áreas envolvidas, traduzindo demandas de negócio em soluções viáveis;
  • Propor inovações aplicáveis ao roadmap do produto, realizando provas de conceito e estudos de caso que aumentem competitividade, eficiência e qualidade da solução;
  • Participar de discussões táticas e operacionais, contribuindo na definição de metas anuais, estudos de viabilidade técnica e escolhas estratégicas de tecnologia;
  • Orientar, capacitar e apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na definição de soluções de negócio, arquitetura e design, promovendo disseminação de conhecimento e boas práticas;
  • Criar frameworks, componentes reutilizáveis e padrões técnicos quando necessário para acelerar e qualificar o desenvolvimento;
  • Definir, revisar e aprimorar processos de engenharia que suportem os objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área de atuação;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;
  • Contribuir em fóruns e discussões sobre inovação e tendências de mercado, disseminando conhecimento e fortalecendo a cultura de aprendizado constante;
  • Atuar diretamente na resolução de incidentes, investigando causas raiz e implementando melhorias que aumentem a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência da plataforma;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

title: Virtual Executive Assistant - Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.

This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Back End - .NET Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 57466


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei desenvolvedor(a), venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência comprovada com desenvolvimento em .NET, aplicando boas práticas de codificação.
  • Experiência com DevOps.
  • Vivência prática com serviços AWS (S3, EC2, EKS, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, entre outros).
  • Conhecimento técnico em Node.js e Python.
  • Experiência em conteinerização de aplicações.
  • Conhecimento em React, Next.js e TypeScript.
  • Diferencial: familiaridade com Minimal API e certificação AWS.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR)


About Us

XDRhub is a specialized sales and business development outsourcing company. We are professional cold-callers dedicated to helping small and mid-sized businesses grow through tailored outbound strategies. Our mission is simple: empower our clients to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace by building their pipelines with high-quality opportunities.


About the Role

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) , you will represent one of our clients and act as the first point of contact for prospective buyers. Your primary responsibility is to proactively identify, engage, and qualify decision-makers (Directors, VPs, and C-level executives).

This role is highly outbound-driven: you will spend your time cold calling, cold emailing, prospecting via LinkedIn, and using modern sales tools to generate meetings. You’ll run early-stage discovery conversations and hand off qualified opportunities to the sales team.

You’ll be working in a fast-paced environment where communication, persistence, and organization are key.


About You

We are looking for a driven, articulate communicator who thrives in outbound sales.

  • English Proficiency – Excellent oral and written English (C1 level or higher). Native-like fluency is required, as you will be speaking directly with US-based executives.
  • Sales Mindset – Fearless hunter mentality with a proven ability to prospect, cold call, and build pipeline.
  • Experience with Sales Solutions(Preferred) – Prior experience engaging Sales and Revenue executives is a strong plus.
  • Curious & Coachable – Eager to learn and grow; open to feedback, with the ambition to become a top 5% sales professional through our mentoring and training.
  • Self-Starter – Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with team members.
  • Tech-Savvy – Familiar with tools like Salesforce, HubSpot, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar sales enablement platforms.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment .


Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective buyers within target accounts.
  • Cold call and email sales executives (VP of Sales, Head of Sales, Chief Revenue Officer, CEO) to secure meetings and demos.

Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Account Executives to confirm appointments, share call notes, and ensure smooth handoffs.
  • Communicate relevant insights from discovery calls to support the sales team’s success.

Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of outreach, leads, conversations, and pipeline progress in both our CRM and client CRMs.
  • Track activity, outcomes, and ensure reporting is up to date.

Metrics & KPIs

  • Number of dials per day (100+ average) and meeting conversion rate.
  • Number of meaningful conversations and meetings booked.
  • Email outreach volume and reply rate.
  • Meeting attendance rate.

Schedule

  • Full-time, 40 hours/week.
  • Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM ET.
  • Open to applicants based in LATAM.

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + commission (60/40 split).
  • SPIFFs and performance incentives.
  • Training, mentoring, and growth opportunities to become a top-performing sales professional.

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de software, dados e integrações com IA , garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com vivência como referência técnica, arquiteto ou liderança técnica de times.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

  • Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos
  • APIs REST e boas práticas de API First
  • Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software
  • Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps
  • Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud)
  • Banco de dados relacionais, PostgreSQL ou equivalentes
  • NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes
  • Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes
  • IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações
  • Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes
  • DevOps: CI e CD, Git, GitFlow, Docker, Kubernetes e infraestrutura como código
  • Provedores de cloud, GCP, AWS ou Azure
  • Observabilidade (Logs estruturados, métricas e traces)
  • Atuação em ambientes distribuídos com foco em confiabilidade (Troubleshooting em produção)
  • Metodologias ágeis

title: Lead Software Engineer
description:
This position is fully remote and CLT model and salary range is 20k-28k BRL/mo.


Must‑haves:

  • 8+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with strong emphasis on PHP
  • Minimum 1 year of lead development experience (technical leadership, guidance, oversight)
  • Strong PHP 7.x and 8.x background (ideally working with PHP in the most recent project) – Comfortable upgrading PHP versions and eliminating underlying vulnerabilities
  • Hands‑on experience with Node.js — updating underlying libraries and ensuring proper packaging
  • Experience with Docker containerization (application‑side responsibilities, not Kubernetes cluster management)


Day‑to‑Day:

In this role, you’ll lead a small engineering team (3–5 developers) while remaining hands‑on with PHP and Node.js development. You’ll help scope work, estimate story points, guide best practices, and ensure high‑quality delivery as the team modernizes and migrates legacy applications. This includes supporting a large‑scale infrastructure initiative to containerize and move roughly 40 legacy PHP applications onto a Kubernetes‑based platform. The work involves lift‑and‑shift migration with targeted refactoring—preserving the existing codebase, reducing redundancy across applications, containerizing services, and helping move source control into GitHub with updated CI/CD pipelines. You’ll partner closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams to ensure application standards and deployment requirements are met throughout the modernization effort.

title: Auxiliar de produção de Equipamentos Eletrônicos
description:
Buscamos AUXILIAR DE PRODUÇÃO para trabalhar presencialmente em Cachoeirinha/RS na Montagem de produtos eletrônicos .

Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional comprovada, salário entre R$ 1.872,00 (Durante o contrato de experiência) e R$ 2.002,00 (Após o contrato de experiência).

A Schalter é uma empresa fabricante de produtos eletrônicos, também com atuação no segmento da tecnologia da informação, mais especificamente provedora de produtos, serviços e soluções tecnológicas integradas de automação comercial, bancária, industrial e de informática.

Nossa experiência de 32 anos de atuação nos permitiu obter conhecimento e credibilidade para oferecer soluções customizadas para empresas de diversos setores e que se encontram em diferentes estágios de desenvolvimento e porte.

Venha se juntar à nossa equipe, esta pode ser a tua oportunidade se você deseja construir um futuro sólido, sustentável e desenvolver sua carreira.

  • Cooperação com a Equipe de Produção, montagem, testes e embalagem de produtos a serem expedidos para clientes
  • Realizar atividades operacionais tais como recebimento de materiais e produtos para produção
  • Organização, limpeza e zelo pelos materiais e recursos necessários ao trabalho
  • Executar procedimentos de controle de qualidade

Habilidades desejáveis

  • Proatividade
  • Comunicativo, boa dicção
  • Dinâmico
  • Foco no resultado e obtenção de metas estabelecidas
  • Visão Analítica
  • Agir com equilíbrio emocional
  • Trabalhar com ética
  • A capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe
  • Ser detalhista aos processos e registros

  • Ensino médio em andamento
  • Coordenação motora
  • Atenção concentrada
  • Senso de segurança

Requisitos desejável para o cargo

  • Ensino médio completo
  • No mínimo 1 ano de experiência em produção e montagem de produtos

Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional (Faixa salaria entre R$ 1.872,00 (Durante o contrato de experiência) e R$ 2.002,00 (Após o contrato de experiência)
  • VT: De acordo com itinerário (Exclusivamente se usar transporte público, mediante regras de vale transporte de acordo com CLT)
  • VR

  • Day OFF: Dia de folga como prémio para comemoração do aniversário conforme política definida pela empresa

Tipo de emprego

  • Formato: Presencial - 44 horas semanais
  • Jornada: Segunda a quinta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 18:00, Sexta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 17:00
  • Local de trabalho: Avenida Frederico Augusto Ritter, 520, Cachoeirinha, RS, BR

Setor

  • Área produtiva, se reporta para o gestor da Produção

Tipo de emprego

  • Tempo integral

Contrato de experiência

  • 90 (noventa) dias

title: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
About You

You are a proactive DevOps Engineer who enjoys building, automating, and maintaining reliable cloud infrastructure. You take ownership of environments end to end from access management and CI/CD pipelines to Kubernetes workloads and you thrive in fast-paced environments where stability, security, and scalability are critical. You’re looking for a role where you can grow your cloud expertise, influence infrastructure decisions, and collaborate closely with engineering teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency with AWS services, particularly IAM, RDS, and EKS.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Solid background designing, implementing, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and container orchestration concepts.
  • Experience with scripting and automation using Python and/or Bash (desirable).
  • AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, permissions, and access management.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will collaborate with global and US-based teams.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Provision and manage AWS accounts, organizational permissions, IAM roles, and cost monitoring.
  • Manage and support both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure smooth and secure operations.
  • Handle workstation setups, configurations, and deprovisioning during employee onboarding and offboarding.
  • Implement, manage, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for consistent and repeatable deployments.
  • Oversee AWS IAM roles and permissions for users, services, and applications.
  • Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS.
  • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support secure, reliable, and efficient deployments.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve infrastructure reliability, scalability, and automation.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to enhance operational efficiency, security, and cost optimization.


Additional Information

title: Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional
description:
Global Process Data Consultant (OTC/MTO)/ SAP functional

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: 12+ Months



This role will be SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration - experience is required.


Position Purpose:

Client is currently undertaking several large-scale global transformation projects.

Each of which requires conversion and migration of data, and ongoing process (reference,

conditional, configuration, transactional, and etc..) data management. We are seeking

experienced SAP S/4HANA Functional Process Data Experts to support a global greenfield

S/4HANA implementation across all value streams (RTR, PTD, PLM, STP, OTC…business

processes. This role is critical to ensuring that business data is fit-for-purpose,

standardized, governed, and ready to enable successful process design, system build,

migration, and adoption.

The Functional Process Data Expert will act as the bridge between business process

owners, functional SAP teams, and the data enablement organization, ensuring that data

requirements are fully embedded into solution design and execution.


Key Responsibilities

Data Enablement & Solution Design

* Partner with global and regional business stakeholders to define data requirements

aligned to standardized value stream processes.

* Translate business process designs into clear master and transactional data

definitions for S/4HANA.

* Support template design by ensuring consistent data models, attributes, and

hierarchies across geographies.

* Validate data readiness for end-to-end process execution (Plan, Source, Make,

Deliver, Return)

Functional Process Data Ownership


Responsibilities include:

* Defining data objects, attributes, and mandatory fields.

* Supporting business rules, validations, and derivations.

* Aligning data structures to SAP best practices and industry standards.

Data Migration & Readiness

* Support data cleansing, enrichment, and harmonization activities.

* Define and validate data mapping rules from legacy systems to S/4HANA.

* Participate in mock conversions, data loads, and reconciliation activities.

* Ensure data quality thresholds are met prior to cutover.

Data Governance & Standards

* Support the establishment and enforcement of global data standards and policies.

* Work closely with Master Data and Data Governance teams.

* Help define roles, ownership, and stewardship models for value stream data.

* Contribute to data quality monitoring and remediation processes.

Testing, Cutover & Hypercare

* Support functional and integrated testing with a strong focus on data accuracy.

* Validate business scenarios using migrated and created data.

* Support cutover planning and execution from a data perspective.

* Provide post-go-live support and stabilization.


Required Qualifications Experience

* 5+ years of SAP functional experience with strong data focus.

* Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA (greenfield preferred).

* Proven involvement in large-scale, global ERP implementations.

* Deep understanding of value stream business processes and related data objects.

* Experience supporting data migration, cleansing, and validation.

Technical & Functional Skills

* Strong knowledge of SAP master data objects (e.g., Material, Vendor/Business

Partner, BOM, Routings, Pricing, Customer, etc.).

* Understanding of S/4HANA data model changes vs. ECC.

* Experience working with SAP MDG or similar governance tools preferred.

* Familiarity with data migration tools (e.g., SAP Migration Cockpit, LVM, ETL tools).

* Ability to read and interpret functional specs and data models.


Soft Skills

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

* Ability to work across global, cross-functional teams.

* Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced transformation environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or asset-intensive industries.

* Prior role as Functional Data Lead or Data Domain Lead.

* Experience defining global templates and harmonized data models.

* Knowledge of data quality tools and metrics.

They have a customized system, so it will take time for worker to come up to speed.

Must have strong SAP knowledge, understand fields and how they can be used.

Knowledge of master data is not critical, most data will be OTC, A/R data pricing, customer, pricing tables.

Must have recent SAP experience over the last 3 years.

description:
About BingX

  • A leading crypto exchange since 2018
  • With 20 million registered users worldwide
  • Official crypto exchange partner of Chelsea FC
  • User-First, reliable, innovative, and diversified
  • List over 1,000 spot trading pairs
  • Offer over 300 futures trading pairs
  • Integrate with over 80 public chain ecosystems
  • Rank top on CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko
  • TradingView's Best Crypto Exchange for 2021, 2022 & 2023
  • A gateway for the next billion crypto users


Founded in 2018, BingX is a leading cryptocurrency exchange, serving over 20 million users worldwide. BingX offers diversified products and services, including spot, derivatives, copy trading, and asset management – all designed for the evolving needs of users, from beginners to professionals.


BingX is committed to providing a trustworthy platform that empowers users with innovative tools and features to elevate their trading proficiency.


Our current vacancy | Full-time | Long-term | REMOTE


Responsibilities

  • Conduct user audits on the company's risk control platform
  • Monitor for and promptly respond to any abnormal transaction data, making judgments as necessary
  • Continually learn about the platform's rules and enhance personal and professional skills
  • Keep abreast of external competitors' changes in risk control rules and provide suggestions based on current regulations

  • At least 1 year of working experience in risk control/transaction monitoring/customer support
  • Possess business sensitivity and awareness of risk
  • Strong psychological quality with effective communication and judgment skills
  • Strong logical thinking and data collection and analysis abilities
  • Strict adherence to professional ethics and information security and confidentiality in daily work
  • Work Schedule: 12:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Brazil Time)


Working at BingX

  • Join an international and diversified team
  • Great career development in a fast-growing company
  • Be part of the future of finance technology and achieve meaningful goals
  • Competitive market salary and fully remote/work-from-home flexibility
  • Flexibility to observe your local holiday calendar, alongside additional benefits

title: Técnico eletrônico
description:
Buscamos TÉCNICO ELETRÔNICO para trabalhar presencialmente em Cachoeirinha/RS

Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional comprovada, salário entre R$ 2.200,00 (iniciante) até R$ 2.500,00 (pelo menos 2 anos de experiência).

A Schalter é uma empresa fabricante de produtos eletrônicos, também com atuação no segmento da tecnologia da informação, mais especificamente provedora de produtos, serviços e soluções tecnológicas integradas de automação comercial, bancária, industrial e de informática.

Nossa experiência de 34 anos de atuação nos permitiu obter conhecimento e credibilidade para oferecer soluções customizadas para empresas de diversos setores e que se encontram em diferentes estágios de desenvolvimento e porte.

Venha se juntar à nossa equipe, esta pode ser a tua oportunidade se você deseja construir um futuro sólido, sustentável e desenvolver sua carreira.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades

O “Técnico Eletrônico” desempenha um papel fundamental na para manter a linha de produção em funcionamento de maneira eficiente. Suas principais atividades e responsabilidades incluem:

  • Executar a instalação e a manutenção de componentes, sistemas eletrônicos e equipamentos
  • Cooperação com a Equipe de Produção, montagem, manutenção, testes e embalagem de produtos a serem expedidos para clientes
  • Resolução de problemas de produtos e componentes
  • Participar do desenvolvimento de projetos
  • Realizar medições e testes com componentes eletrônicos
  • Executar procedimentos de controle de qualidade

Habilidades desejáveis

  • Proatividade
  • Comunicativo, boa dicção
  • Dinâmico
  • Foco no resultado e obtenção de metas estabelecidas
  • Visão Analítica
  • Agir com equilíbrio emocional
  • Trabalhar com ética
  • A capacidade de trabalhar bem em equipe
  • Ser detalhista aos processos e registros

Requisitos mínimos para o cargo

  • Desejado Curso Técnico em Eletrônica, mecânica ou Informática
  • Conhecimento técnico na solução de problemas em reparos de equipamentos.

Requisitos desejável para o cargo

  • No mínimo 1 ano de experiência

Benefícios:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado baseado nas competências e experiência profissional (Faixa salaria entre R$ 2.200,00 (iniciante) até R$ 2.500,00 (pelo menos 2 anos de experiência)
  • VT: De acordo com itinerário (Exclusivamente se usar transporte público, mediante regras de vale transporte de acordo com CLT)
  • VR
  • Plano de saúde ambulatorial e odonto após contrato de experiência
  • PPLR
  • Day OFF: Dia de folga como prémio para comemoração do aniversário conforme política definida pela empresa

Tipo de emprego

  • Vinculo: CLT
  • Formato: Presencial - 44 horas semanais
  • Jornada: Segunda a quinta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 18:00, Sexta-feira das 08:00 as 12:30 e das 13:30 as 17:00
  • Local de trabalho: Avenida Frederico Augusto Ritter, 520, Cachoeirinha, RS, BR

Setor

  • Área produtiva, se reporta para o gestor da Produção.

Tipo de emprego

  • Tempo integral

Contrato de experiência

  • 90 (noventa) dias

title: Guest Services Coordinator
description:
We are partnering with a global corporate housing provider to recruit a Guest Services Coordinator for a fully remote position, open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil.


This full-time role is suited to a service-driven professional with strong communication skills and experience within guest services, relocation, or a fast-paced customer service environment. The successful candidate will support end-to-end guest experiences, ensuring high service standards are maintained at all times.


Responsibilities:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for guests throughout their temporary accommodation stay.
  • Manage and resolve guest-reported maintenance and service issues promptly and professionally.
  • Process client extension requests accurately and efficiently.
  • Deliver a consistently high level of customer service with strong attention to detail.
  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of monthly guest services reports.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and support implementation initiatives.
  • Issue move-out instructions and extension notices as required.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of in-house guest issues within internal systems.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours emergency phone rota to manage urgent guest matters.
  • Communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically via phone and email with guests and internal teams.
  • Work collaboratively while managing responsibilities independently in a remote setting.


Requirements:

  • Previous experience in guest services, relocation, corporate housing, hotel/hospitality or a related customer service role is highly desirable.
  • Ability to remain calm and solution-focused in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Strong IT proficiency, particularly Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Professional, customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
  • Highly organised, self-motivated, and comfortable working remotely.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Job Description:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

This contract position is open to remote candidates outside the United States in North/South America and will report to the Sr. Manager of DevOps Engineering.

What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.

Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST

Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Job Description:

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support our cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a dynamic environment leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Postgres, and Terraform. In this role, you will participate in automating infrastructure provisioning, managing containerized applications, and maintaining CI/CD workflows to ensure smooth and scalable deployments. You will work closely with senior engineers to troubleshoot issues, implement best practices, and enhance system reliability and performance across multi-cloud platforms. This is an excellent opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, collaborative DevOps environment.

This contract position is open to remote candidates outside the United States in North/South America and will report to the Sr. Manager of DevOps Engineering.

What you get to do every day:

-Participate in an on-call rotation on a regular basis and respond to incidents reliably and professionally.

-Maintain and evolve our AWS cloud infrastructure, employing automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.

-Build and maintain our code pipelines, designing and building automation in order to enable agile software development, using self-service where possible.

-Collaborate efficiently and effectively with other team members and Software Engineers to solve complex problems.

-Quickly absorb context and knowledge while ramping up.

Skills/Experience:

Minimum Requirements:

-4-6 years experience in SRE, DevOps, or similar role

-Experience with cloud provider platforms such as AWS or GCP

-Experience with relational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL)

-Familiarity with Kubernetes

- Experience with GitOps CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)

- Familiarity with declarative infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)

-Exposure to logging, monitoring, metrics collection, and observability tools (e.g., DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, CloudWatch)

- Collaboration with other engineers working primarily in PST

Desired Skills (Nice to Haves):

- Experience with software development and automation in languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., golang, python, elixir, java, etc.)

- Experience with platform development of tools for development, staging, and integration environments

- Experience with debugging performance or networking issues in applications running on Kubernetes

- Experience with audit compliance (e.g., SOX, SOC2, ISO27001, PCI DSS)

- Working knowledge of UNIX-based Operating Systems

-Computer Science or Engineering degree


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: AI Automation Engineer
description:
Buscamos um(a) profissional especializado(a) em automação inteligente com Inteligência Artificial, com atuação de ponta a ponta, da arquitetura à implementação em produção. Esse papel é estratégico na criação de soluções escaláveis, seguras e inovadoras, conectando engenharia de software, IA aplicada a processos de negócio, automação de fluxos e cloud computing.


O profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de agentes autônomos inteligentes, integrações complexas entre sistemas e orquestração de automações em ambientes multi-cloud, colaborando com squads multidisciplinares.


O modelo de contrato para esta oportunidade é CLT.


Somos inquietos, somos desbravadores e estamos em constante transformação.


Por isso, estamos na busca constante de crescimento do nosso time com profissionais inovadores, que desafiam os limites e estejam preparados para embarcar nessa cultura.


Seja qual for o seu gênero, orientação sexual, idade, raça, etnia, crença ou deficiência, todos são bem-vindos no nosso time.


Responsabilidades Principais


Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de automação com IA, integradas a ambientes multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).


Desenvolver, treinar e evoluir agentes autônomos e assistentes virtuais utilizando LLMs, LangChain, RAG, MCP Server e Google Agentspace.


Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados para alimentar modelos de IA e fluxos automatizados.


Integrar bancos de dados relacionais, NoSQL e vetoriais.


Desenvolver APIs e microsserviços escaláveis utilizando Node.js, Python e PHP.


Aplicar engenharia de prompt e arquiteturas multi-agentes em ambientes produtivos.


Desenvolver interfaces front-end leves para monitoramento e controle das automações.


Orquestrar ambientes de Cloud e DevOps com Docker, Git e pipelines CI/CD.


Garantir governança, compliance e rastreabilidade no uso de IA (versionamento de prompts, documentação e observabilidade).


Atuar em squads multidisciplinares, colaborando com times de negócio, design e tecnologia.


Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)


Inglês avançado

Experiência sólida em automação inteligente com IA


Vivência com LLMs e frameworks de IA (LangChain, RAG, OpenAI, Google Vertex AI)


Experiência com ferramentas de automação: n8n, Power Automate, Make ou Zapier


Desenvolvimento back-end com Node.js e/ou Python


Conhecimento em APIs, microsserviços e integração de sistemas


Experiência com Cloud Computing (Azure, AWS ou GCP)


Stack Técnica Desejável

IA & LLMs


OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, LangChain, RAG, Banco de Dados Vetorial, MCP Server


Automação & Orquestração


n8n, Power Automate, Make, Zapier


Agentes Autônomos, Engenharia de Prompt


Back-End


Node.js, Python, PHP


Front-End


ReactJS, Bootstrap, JavaScript


Cloud & DevOps


Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud


Git (GitHub / Bitbucket), Docker, CI/CD


Banco de Dados


SQL Server, Cosmos DB, MongoDB, BigQuery, MySQL


Ferramentas Complementares


Postman, Grafana, Kibana, AI Search


Terraform (diferencial)


Diferenciais

Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud e híbridos.


Integrações com CRM, ERP e Martech (Salesforce, SAP BTP, RD Station, HubSpot).


Certificações em Cloud ou IA (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).


Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ).


Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio em fluxos automatizados mensuráveis.


Modelo de Trabalho

Modelo híbrido (1x por semana presencial) no endereço: Vila Nova Conceição, São Paulo/SP


Perfil Comportamental

Visão sistêmica e pensamento arquitetural.


Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.


Comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio.


Organização, autonomia e senso de responsabilidade.


Interesse contínuo por inovação e evolução em IA.

title: Pesquisador em experiência do usuário
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós?

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho?

  • Conduzir pesquisas com usuários para entender necessidades e comportamentos.
  • Analisar dados e gerar insights para decisões de produto.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com design, produto e engenharia.
  • Documentar e comunicar resultados de forma clara e objetiva.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência em UX Research.
  • Vivência prévia em manufatura ou fabricação de produtos.
  • Experiência com pesquisa aplicada a produtos industriais ou ambientes de produção (diferencial).
  • Conhecimento ou atuação em Service Design (diferencial)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Delphi Especialista (IA)
description:
Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

Atuar como referência técnica do time, liderando o desenvolvimento e a evolução de soluções de

software, dados e integrações com IA, garantindo qualidade técnica, sustentabilidade arquitetural e entrega contínua de valor ao negócio. Conduzir decisões técnicas no dia a dia, apoiar o crescimento do time e assegurar que as soluções sejam escaláveis, observáveis e alinhadas à estratégia da área.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ

  • Liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento, apoiando decisões de design, arquitetura e implementação;
  • Atuar de forma hands on no desenvolvimento de soluções complexas, mantendo proximidade com o código e com os problemas reais do produto;
  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais e não funcionais em soluções técnicas viáveis, avaliando alternativas e escolhendo as soluções tecnológicas mais adequadas, considerando trade-offs de qualidade, prazo, custo, escalabilidade, segurança e impacto operacional;
  • Contribuir ativamente para a evolução da arquitetura de aplicações, dados e integrações, garantindo consistência, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade;
  • Garantir a adoção de boas práticas de engenharia de software, como testes automatizados, versionamento, revisão de código, documentação e integração contínua;
  • Apoiar a construção e evolução de pipelines de dados, integrações assíncronas e soluções que se conectem a modelos de IA quando aplicável;
  • Atuar como ponto de referência técnica para o time, promovendo mentoria, troca de conhecimento e evolução da maturidade técnica;
  • Participar de discussões técnicas com produto, dados e áreas parceiras, apoiando decisões táticas e operacionais;
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria técnica e propor soluções que aumentem eficiência, confiabilidade e qualidade do produto;
  • Criar ou evoluir componentes reutilizáveis, padrões e frameworks/plataformas quando necessário para acelerar o desenvolvimento;
  • Apoiar a priorização técnica do backlog, sinalizando riscos, dependências e impactos arquiteturais;
  • Atuar na análise e resolução de incidentes, investigando causa raiz e propondo melhorias estruturais;
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos processos de engenharia, alinhados aos objetivos de curto e médio prazo da área;
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências de mercado, arquitetura, dados e IA, disseminando conhecimento no time;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento das metas do time, influenciando práticas, priorização de tarefas e promovendo evolução contínua da qualidade técnica;
  • Propor inovações aplicáveis ao roadmap do produto, realizando provas de conceito e estudos de caso que aumentem competitividade, eficiência e qualidade da solução;


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

● Sólida experiência em Desenvolvimento Delphi;

● Domínio no desenvolvimento de APIs (REST-HORSE) e API First;

● Fundamento em testes unitários – Conhecimento em Dunit;

● Unigui e Firemonkey – Nível avançado;

● Banco de Dados PostgreSQL, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Arquitetura de software moderna, cloud native, microsserviços e orientada a eventos;

● Design Patterns, Clean Code e princípios de engenharia de software;

● Segurança no desenvolvimento e práticas de DevSecOps;

● Linguagem de programação avançada (Java ou equivalente) e frameworks (Spring, Spring Boot e Spring Cloud);

● NoSQL, Elastic, MongoDB ou equivalentes;

● Mensageria, RabbitMQ, Pub Sub ou equivalentes;

● IA e LLMs: uso via API, prompts, RAG e integração de IA em aplicações;

● Noções de pipelines de dados, Airflow, Beam ou equivalentes.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager - NAMER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients and internal leadership, ensuring hiring excellence, speed, quality, and alignment with business goals in a highly competitive and innovation-driven market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies for NAMER clients, managing full-cycle recruitment across technical roles within AI/R and technology environments;
  • Partner closely with clients, hiring managers, and executives to understand workforce planning, role requirements, and hiring priorities;
  • Build, manage, and develop high-performing recruiting teams, ensuring delivery excellence, hiring quality, and adherence to SLAs;
  • Design and optimize recruiting processes tailored to the NAMER market, including sourcing strategies, interview frameworks, and candidate experience;
  • Drive hiring initiatives for highly specialized roles, including AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product roles;
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing market insights, talent trends and compensation benchmarks;
  • Ensure compliance with NAMER labor regulations, diversity hiring practices, and internal recruitment standards;
  • Manage recruiting metrics and KPIs;
  • Support employer branding initiatives and represent the company in talent and industry events when applicable;
  • Collaborate with HR, People Operations, and leadership teams to align talent acquisition with broader organizational strategy.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Manager or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner in technology-driven environments;
  • Strong experience recruiting for the NAMER market, with a primary focus on US hiring practices;
  • Demonstrated success hiring for AI, Machine Learning, Data, Cloud, and software engineering roles;
  • Experience managing recruiting teams and working with multiple stakeholders and clients simultaneously;
  • Deep knowledge of full-cycle recruitment, sourcing strategies, and talent market dynamics in NAMER;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

title: Executive Recruiter
description:
Executive Recruiter (Fluent English – C1/C2) | 100% Remote | U.S. Market


Blue Dot BPO connects strategic LATAM talent with mission-critical operations at U.S.-based companies. As we continue to expand, we are looking for an Executive Recruiter to lead high-impact executive hiring processes while working directly with senior leadership teams in the United States.


This is a fully remote role with a high level of autonomy, international exposure, and end-to-end ownership of executive recruiting processes.


What We Offer

  • Fixed pay of R$5,000 , plus additional bonuses in USD
  • Fully remote work (Monday to Friday, 1 PM to 10 PM BRT )
  • Long-term contract with real growth opportunities
  • Strategic exposure to U.S.-based executives and C-level teams
  • Multicultural, performance-driven environment focused on process, accountability, and meritocracy


Your Responsibilities

  • Lead full-cycle executive recruitment for senior and leadership roles
  • Develop advanced sourcing strategies and market mapping
  • Conduct structured interviews and in-depth candidate assessments
  • Manage strategic pipelines and stakeholder relationships
  • Coordinate interview processes with U.S.-based teams
  • Ensure operational excellence in ATS usage and recruitment data


What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience in executive recruiting / headhunting
  • Fluent English (C1/C2) for daily professional communication
  • Hunter mindset , analytical thinking, and strong results orientation
  • Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, and job boards
  • Strong communication skills, a consultative approach , and high organizational standards


Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in full-cycle executive recruiting
  • Familiarity with U.S. recruiting practices and market


Technical Requirements

  • Laptop with i7 processor (or equivalent) and 12GB+ RAM
  • Two monitors for daily operations
  • High-speed internet
  • Professional headset
  • Quiet and structured home office environment


Build Your International Career

If you want to work directly with the U.S. market, gain executive-level recruiting experience, and grow in a high-performance, process-driven environment, this opportunity is for you.


Apply now and become part of Blue Dot BPO.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!
